about_the_game: F1® 25 players can get behind the wheel of the APXGP car and experience the key moments of F1® The Movie through immersive in-game chapter scenarios inspired by the film, through a cinematic blend of storytelling and high-octane gameplay. Add Sonny Hayes and Joshua Pearce to your Driver Market, and equip your personal driver with Joshua Pearce’s helmet in F1® World or Driver Career. Conclude your journey with a thrilling final challenge that mirrors the film’s dramatic climax under the lights of Abu Dhabi. Finally, complete all chapters to unlock Sonny Hayes’ helmet for your personal driver.
